notes: Four distinct movable-part episodes are visible: two separate drawers and the two independently manipulated doors of the central upper cabinet. The initial and final kitchen traversals contain no additional visible state changes.
scene_description: A user surveys a narrow galley kitchen, then opens and closes a drawer beside the refrigerator, separately opens and closes both doors of the upper cabinet above the stove, and finally opens and closes a drawer on the opposite side of the stove.
